# ---- Output folder, data QA and design constants ----
locate <- function() {
  for (f in rev(sys.frames())) {
    p <- f$ofile
    if (is.character(p) && length(p)==1L && file.exists(p)) return(dirname(normalizePath(p)))
  }
  s <- grep("^--file=",commandArgs(FALSE),value=TRUE)
  if(length(s)) { p <- sub("^--file=","",s[1]); if(file.exists(p)) return(dirname(normalizePath(p))) }
  getwd()
}
root <- Sys.getenv("FWKC_FIGURE_OUTPUT",unset="")
if(!nzchar(root)) root <- file.path(locate(), paste0("FWKC_V42_Figures_R_",format(Sys.time(),"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")))
if(dir.exists(root) && length(list.files(root,all.files=TRUE,no..=TRUE))) stop("Output directory exists and is not empty. Select a fresh FWKC_FIGURE_OUTPUT.")
dir.create(root,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
root <- normalizePath(root,mustWork=TRUE)
for(s in c("TIFF_800dpi","PDF_vector","PNG_review","Figure_Data")) dir.create(file.path(root,s),showWarnings=FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(historical)==13L,nrow(independent)==5L,nrow(clustered)==6L,
          sum(independent$n)==6000L,sum(clustered$n)==6000L,
          sum(independent$gaussian_n,clustered$gaussian_n)==10801L,
          sum(independent$ellipsoid_n,clustered$ellipsoid_n)==11694L,
          sum(independent$e_only,clustered$e_only)==893L,
          sum(independent$g_only,clustered$g_only)==0L,
          nrow(clinical_band)==401L,nrow(widthmatched)==12L,
          all(is.finite(nominal$mean_halfwidth)),all(nominal$n==1000L))
# Clinical figures use the exact aggregate 2x2 counts; participant records are not embedded.
ct0 <- as.numeric(unlist(clinical_counts[1,c("TP","FP","FN","TN")],use.names=FALSE))
ct1 <- as.numeric(unlist(clinical_counts[2,c("TP","FP","FN","TN")],use.names=FALSE))
N <- sum(ct0); stopifnot(N==6070, sum(ct1)==N)
p <- (ct0[1]+ct0[3])/N; a <- ct0[1]/N; b <- ct0[2]/N; u <- (ct1[1]-ct0[1])/N; v <- (ct1[2]-ct0[2])/N
cgrid <- clinical_band$c; q0 <- a+b; q1 <- q0+u+v
k0 <- (a-p*q0)/(cgrid*p+(1-cgrid)*q0-p*q0)
k1 <- (a+u-p*q1)/(cgrid*p+(1-cgrid)*q1-p*q1)
ck <- -(1-p)*(b*u-a*v)/(a*v-b*u-p^2*(u+v)+p*u)
cl <- v/(u+v)
curve <- data.frame(c=cgrid,initial=k0,OR=k1,delta=k1-k0,loss_per_1000=1000*(v-cgrid*(u+v)))
stopifnot(max(abs(curve$delta-clinical_band$delta))<1e-10,abs(ck-0.1185318928708668)<1e-12,abs(cl-17/55)<1e-12)
# Export all exact embedded numerical inputs; full precision CSV, rather than rounded labels.
for (nm in c("historical","independent","clustered","nominal","widthmatched","clinical_counts","clinical_band","stress","failure_dgm","risk","crossovers","masking","curve")) {
  write.csv(get(nm),file.path(root,"Figure_Data",paste0(nm,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
}
blue <- "#22587B"; teal <- "#178078"; orange <- "#BD722A"; gray <- "#9BABB7"; red <- "#A64B4B"; slate <- "#5B6770"
cols <- c(blue,teal,orange,gray,"#674C91","#AD536A","#567441","#525252")
D <- c("G30 common moderate known","G30 rare moderate known","G30 rare sparse known","G10 common moderate known","G10 rare sparse known","G30 common moderate estimated")
DL <- c("30 sites\nCommon","30 sites\nRare, moderate","30 sites\nRare, sparse","10 sites\nCommon","10 sites\nRare, sparse","30 sites\nEstimated e")
M4 <- c("Gaussian max","Ellipsoid chi-square","Ellipsoid t-inflated","Hotelling F")
M7 <- c(M4,"Multivariate max-t","Wild score-t","Bonferroni t")
MN <- c("Gaussian-max","Chi-square ellipsoid","t-adjusted ellipsoid","Hotelling-F","Multivariate max-t","Wild score-t","Bonferroni-t")
MC <- c(slate,blue,teal,orange,"#6E5C8F","#AD536A","#535353"); MP <- c(16,15,18,17,3,4,6)
getmat <- function(dat, rowvar, rowkeys, colvar, colkeys, val) {
  a <- sapply(colkeys,function(k) {
    s <- dat[dat[[colvar]]==k,,drop=FALSE]; idx <- match(rowkeys,s[[rowvar]])
    if(anyNA(idx)||anyDuplicated(s[[rowvar]])) stop("Missing or duplicate plotting keys: ",k)
    s[[val]][idx]
  }); dimnames(a) <- list(rowkeys,colkeys); stopifnot(all(is.finite(a))); a
}
style <- function(mar=c(4.7,4.8,2.2,1.2)) {
  par(mar=mar,mgp=c(2.7,.75,0),tcl=-.22,bty="l",las=1,cex.lab=1,cex.axis=.87,cex.main=1.02,lwd=1,family="sans",xaxs="i",yaxs="i")
}
leg <- function(labels,colors, ncol=length(labels), fill=TRUE,cex=.84) {
  if(fill) legend("top",inset=c(0,-.16),legend=labels,fill=colors,border=NA,bty="n",xpd=NA,ncol=ncol,cex=cex)
  else legend("top",inset=c(0,-.16),legend=labels,col=colors,pch=seq_along(labels)-1,lty=1,bty="n",xpd=NA,ncol=ncol,cex=cex)
}
hbar <- function(mat,labs,colors,xlab,xlim,legends=NULL,ref=NULL,margin=11.7) {
  style(c(4.5,margin,4.1,1.7)); mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  height <- if(ncol(mat)==1L) rev(mat[,1]) else t(mat[nrow(mat):1,,drop=FALSE])
  pos <- barplot(height,beside=TRUE,horiz=TRUE,col=colors,border=NA,axes=FALSE,axisnames=FALSE,xlim=xlim,xlab=xlab,space=if(ncol(mat)==1L) .30 else c(.10,.55))
  at <- if(is.matrix(pos)) colMeans(pos) else pos
  axis(2,at=at,labels=rev(labs),las=1,tick=FALSE,cex.axis=.82,line=-.25); axis(1); box(bty="l")
  if(!is.null(ref)) abline(v=ref,lty=2,col=red,lwd=1.2)
  if(!is.null(legends)) leg(legends,colors,length(legends))
}
cover <- function(z) hbar(z[,c("wald","gaussian","ellipsoid")],z$label,c(gray,blue,teal),"Simultaneous coverage across 121 weights (%)",c(0,105),c("Pointwise Wald, jointly","Gaussian-max","Linearized ellipsoid"),95)
widthplot <- function(z) hbar(z[,c("g_halfwidth","e_halfwidth")],z$label,c(blue,teal),"Mean band half-width",c(0,max(z$e_halfwidth)*1.09),c("Gaussian-max","Linearized ellipsoid"))
# Each function draws a fresh plot on any opened graphics device. Figures use labels in V41 PDF.
plots <- list()
plots[["01"]] <- function(){
  h <- historical[order(historical$failure_pct,decreasing=TRUE),]; hbar(matrix(h$failure_pct,ncol=1),h$label,ifelse(grepl("PROJECTED",rev(h$method)),teal,blue),"Mean failed point estimates (%)",c(0,48),margin=12.5)
}
plots[["02"]] <- function(){ hbar(historical[,c("issuance","conditional")],historical$label,c(blue,teal),"Across-cell mean (%)",c(0,105),c("Interval issuance","Conditional coverage"),95,margin=12.5) }
plots[["03"]] <- function(){cover(independent)}
plots[["04"]] <- function(){widthplot(independent)}
plots[["05"]] <- function(){cover(clustered)}
plots[["06"]] <- function(){widthplot(clustered)}
plots[["07"]] <- function(){hbar(matrix(100-clustered$feasible,ncol=1),clustered$label,orange,"Raw estimate infeasible or unavailable (%)",c(0,27))}
plots[["08"]] <- function(){
  style(c(6.2,4.6,1.1,1.2)); a <- getmat(nominal,"design",D,"method",M4,"coverage")
  matplot(seq_along(D),a,type="o",pch=MP[1:4],lty=c(2,1,1,1),col=MC[1:4],lwd=1.6,xaxt="n",xlab="",ylab="Simultaneous coverage (%)",ylim=c(75,102),xlim=c(.65,6.35))
  axis(1,at=1:6,labels=DL,cex.axis=.78,tick=FALSE,line=.1); abline(h=95,lty=2,col=red)
  legend("bottom",inset=c(0,-.34),legend=c(MN[1:4],"Nominal 95%"),col=c(MC[1:4],red),pch=c(MP[1:4],NA),lty=c(2,1,1,1,2),ncol=3,bty="n",xpd=NA,cex=.78)
}
plots[["09"]] <- function(){
  layout(matrix(c(1,2,3,3),nrow=2,byrow=TRUE),heights=c(4.8,1.15))
  for(i in seq_along(c(D[5],D[3]))) {
    key <- c(D[5],D[3])[i]; sub <- nominal[nominal$design==key,,drop=FALSE]; sub <- sub[match(M7,sub$method),,drop=FALSE]
    stopifnot(nrow(sub)==7L,!anyNA(sub$method)); style(c(4.2,4.4,2.2,1.0))
    w <- sub$mean_halfwidth; y <- sub$coverage; lim <- range(w)+c(-1,1)*max(diff(range(w))*.07,.005)
    plot(w,y,pch=MP,col=MC,cex=1.2,xlab="Mean half-width",ylab="Simultaneous coverage (%)",xlim=lim,ylim=c(77,102),main=c("(a) 10 sites: rare / sparse","(b) 30 sites: rare / sparse")[i]); abline(h=95,col=red,lty=2)
  }
  par(mar=c(0,0,0,0)); plot.new(); legend("center",legend=c(MN,"Nominal 95%"),col=c(MC,red),pch=c(MP,NA),lty=c(rep(0,7),2),ncol=3,bty="n",cex=.83)
}

}

}

stopifnot(nrow(sens_ref)==405L,nrow(sens_pc)==162L,nrow(sens_dn)==30L)
dg41 <- c("BASE","IID","HIGH_CLUSTER","STRONG_PAIR","LOW_RETEST")
dg41lab <- c("Reference","Independent","High cluster","Strong pair","Low retest")
heat41 <- function(z,field,title,zlim,palette,zero=FALSE) {
 xx <- sort(unique(z$C)); yy <- sort(unique(z$P)); zz <- tapply(z[[field]],list(z$C,z$P),identity)
 image(xx,yy,zz,col=palette,zlim=zlim,xlab="Loss weight C",ylab="Prevalence P",main=title,cex.main=.82,axes=FALSE)
 axis(1,at=c(.1,.5,.9));axis(2,at=c(.1,.5,.9));box()
 if(zero && min(zz,na.rm=TRUE)<0 && max(zz,na.rm=TRUE)>0) contour(xx,yy,zz,levels=0,drawlabels=FALSE,add=TRUE,lwd=1.3)
}
key41 <- function(zlim,palette,label) {
 par(mar=c(3,1,2,4)); v<-seq(zlim[1],zlim[2],length.out=length(palette)); image(1:2,v,matrix(rep(v,each=2),2),col=palette,axes=FALSE,xlab="",ylab="");axis(4,las=1,cex.axis=.75);mtext(label,side=3,cex=.8);box()
}
plots[["S6"]] <- function(){
 par(mfrow=c(2,3),mar=c(3.7,3.7,2.3,.9),mgp=c(2.2,.65,0),cex=.8)
 lim<-max(abs(sens_ref$DELTA)); pal<-colorRampPalette(c("#B2182B","#F7F7F7","#2166AC"))(100)
 for(i in seq_along(dg41)) heat41(subset(sens_ref,DGM==dg41[i]),"DELTA",dg41lab[i],c(-lim,lim),pal,TRUE)
 key41(c(-lim,lim),pal,"Reference kappa contrast")
}
plots[["S7"]] <- function(){
 par(mfrow=c(2,3),mar=c(3.8,3.8,2.4,.9),mgp=c(2.2,.65,0),cex=.82)
 m<-c("RF_AIPW_GUARDED_PROJECTED","CF_RIDGE_PROJECTED"); lab<-c("Guarded projected RF","Projected CF ridge")
 rlim<-c(0,max(sens_pc$mean_conditional_rmse));clim<-c(min(sens_pc$mean_conditional),1)
 p1<-colorRampPalette(c("#440154","#21918C","#FDE725"))(100);p2<-colorRampPalette(c("#00204C","#7F7C75","#FDE737"))(100)
 for(i in 1:2) heat41(subset(sens_pc,method==m[i]),"mean_conditional_rmse",lab[i],rlim,p1)
 key41(rlim,p1,"Conditional RMSE")
 for(i in 1:2) heat41(subset(sens_pc,method==m[i]),"mean_conditional",lab[i],clim,p2)
 key41(clim,p2,"Conditional coverage")
}
plots[["S8"]] <- function(){
 par(mfrow=c(1,3),mar=c(4.8,3.8,2.5,.8),mgp=c(2.1,.6,0),cex=.78,oma=c(2,0,0,0))
 cs<-c("#2166AC","#777777","#018571","#B35806","#9E0142"); fields<-c("mean_failure_pct","mean_conditional_rmse","mean_conditional"); labs<-c("Point failure (%)","Conditional RMSE","Conditional coverage (%)")
 for(j in 1:3){ scale<-if(j==3)100 else 1; yr<-range(scale*sens_dn[[fields[j]]],if(j==3)95 else NULL);plot(NA,xlim=range(sens_dn$n),ylim=yr,log="x",xaxt="n",xlab="Sample size n",ylab=labs[j]);axis(1,at=c(30,100,1000),labels=c(30,100,1000));grid();if(j==3)abline(h=95,lty=2)
 for(i in 1:5){z<-subset(sens_dn,DGM==dg41[i]);z<-z[order(z$n),];lines(z$n,scale*z[[fields[j]]],type="b",pch=16,cex=.65,col=cs[i],lwd=1.3)}
 if(j==1)legend("topright",legend=dg41lab,col=cs,lty=1,pch=16,bty="n",cex=.57)
 }
}
plots[["S9"]] <- function(){
 par(mfrow=c(1,2),mar=c(4.1,4.1,2.4,1.5),mgp=c(2.3,.7,0),cex=.85)
 pp<-seq(.01,.99,.01);cc<-seq(0,1,.01);s0<-ct0[1]/(ct0[1]+ct0[3]);f0<-ct0[2]/(ct0[2]+ct0[4]);eta1<-(ct1[1]-ct0[1])/(ct0[1]+ct0[3]);eta0<-(ct1[2]-ct0[2])/(ct0[2]+ct0[4]);k<-function(p,c,se,f){q<-p*se+(1-p)*f;(p*se-p*q)/(c*p+(1-c)*q-p*q)}
 zz<-outer(cc,pp,function(c,p)k(p,c,s0+eta1,f0+eta0)-k(p,c,s0,f0)); lim<-max(abs(zz));pal<-colorRampPalette(c("#B2182B","#F7F7F7","#2166AC"))(100)
 image(cc,pp,zz,col=pal,zlim=c(-lim,lim),xlab="Loss weight C",ylab="Assumed prevalence P",main="(a) Agreement contrast");contour(cc,pp,zz,levels=0,add=TRUE,drawlabels=FALSE);abline(h=p,lty=2,col="gray30")
 r<-subset(sens_roots,subset=="All");r<-r[order(r$P),];plot(r$P,r$c_kappa,type="l",col=blue,lwd=2,xlim=c(0,1),ylim=c(0,1),xlab="Assumed prevalence P",ylab="Crossover weight",main="(b) Crossover sensitivity");lines(r$P,r$c_loss,col=orange,lwd=2);points(c(p,p),c(ck,cl),pch=16,col=c(blue,orange));legend("topright",c("Agreement","Direct loss"),col=c(blue,orange),lty=1,lwd=2,bty="n",cex=.8)
}

plots[["S10"]] <- function(){
 par(mfrow=c(2,3),mar=c(3.2,3.6,2.1,.65),mgp=c(2,.6,0),cex=.8,oma=c(1.2,0,0,0))
 mm<-c("Reference clustered setting","Independent observations","Strong site heterogeneity","Strong within-patient dependence","Sparse retesting"); labs<-c("Reference clustered","Independent","High cluster heterogeneity","Strong paired dependence","Sparse retesting"); cl<-c("#B44D40","#2166AC")
 for(i in seq_along(mm)){
  a<-endpoint_ref[endpoint_ref$mechanism==mm[i],]; plot(NA,xlim=c(.1,.9),ylim=range(endpoint_ref$Delta,0),xlab="Prevalence P",ylab="Reference kappa contrast",main=labs[i],xaxt="n");axis(1,at=c(.1,.5,.9));abline(h=0,lty=3,col="gray60");
  for(j in 1:2){z<-a[a$C==j-1,];z<-z[order(z$P),];lines(z$P,z$Delta,type="b",pch=c(16,15)[j],col=cl[j],lwd=1.4,cex=.7)}
 };plot.new();legend("center",c("C = 0","C = 1"),col=cl,lty=1,pch=c(16,15),bty="n")
}
plots[["S11"]] <- function(){
 par(mfrow=c(2,6),mar=c(2.8,2.3,2.8,.4),mgp=c(1.45,.45,0),cex=.64,oma=c(3,1,0,0))
 ds<-c("G30 common moderate known","G30 rare moderate known","G30 rare sparse known","G10 common moderate known","G10 rare sparse known","G30 common moderate estimated"); lab<-c("30 / common","30 / rare","30 / sparse","10 / common","10 / sparse","30 / fitted e"); me<-c("Gaussian max","Ellipsoid chi-square","Ellipsoid t-inflated");cl<-c("#777777","#2166AC","#018571"); sy<-c(16,15,17)
 for(k in 1:2)for(i in seq_along(ds)){
  a<-endpoint_mc[endpoint_mc$design==ds[i]&endpoint_mc$method%in%me,]; field<-if(k==1)"coverage" else "halfwidth"; f<-if(k==1)100 else 1; r<-if(k==1)c(75,101) else range(endpoint_mc$halfwidth[endpoint_mc$method%in%me]);plot(NA,xlim=c(0,1),ylim=r,xlab="",ylab=if(i==1)if(k==1)"Membership (%)" else "Half-width" else "",xaxt="n",main=if(k==1)lab[i] else "");axis(1,at=c(0,.5,1));if(k==1)abline(h=95,col="#B44D40",lty=2)
  for(j in 1:3){z<-a[a$method==me[j],];z<-z[order(z$C),];lines(z$C,f*z[[field]],type="b",pch=sy[j],col=cl[j],lwd=1.4,cex=.7)}
 };mtext("Loss weight C",side=1,outer=TRUE,line=.8);mtext("Gray: Gaussian-max | Blue: chi-square E | Green: t-adjusted E",side=1,outer=TRUE,line=2,cex=.8)
}

size <- rbind(size,c(7.05,4.65),c(7.05,4.5))
ids <- c(sprintf("%02d",1:14),paste0("S",1:11));stopifnot(identical(names(plots),ids),nrow(size)==length(ids))
source_descr <- c("v102 MANUSCRIPT_01_BIAS_RMSE_MCSE; all DELTA design cells","v102 MANUSCRIPT_MF_FULL_REFIT_COVERAGE_CORRECTED; valid-status DELTA cells","V30 embedded SAI_sim_replicates.csv; all attempts","V30 embedded SAI_sim_replicates.csv; finite widths","EXTENDED cluster_replications(1).csv; all attempts","EXTENDED cluster_replications(1).csv; finite widths","EXTENDED cluster_replications(1).csv; complement of all-attempt feasibility","V39 replications.csv.gz; phase=evaluation, AIPW","V39 replications.csv.gz; phase=evaluation, AIPW, rare/sparse designs","V39 width_matched_t_budget_summary.csv; Wild score-t","6070 complete pairs; count-derived kappa","6070 complete pairs; count-derived contrast","6070 complete pairs; stipulated direct loss","V30 embedded TU_AH_tuah_band.csv; archived working-independence band","Archived repaired HF summary (54 cells; no certificate; primary repair RDS unavailable)","v102 point-summary DGM means","v102 point-summary risk computed by failure penalty","V30 Manuscript_Table_03_ARCHIVED_SUMMARY.csv; archived rounded root summaries","V30 Manuscript_Table_10_ARCHIVED_SUMMARY.csv; archived weight-specific RMSE")
np <- if(capabilities("cairo")) "cairo" else if(.Platform$OS.type=="windows") "windows" else getOption("bitmapType")
if(!capabilities("cairo") && .Platform$OS.type!="windows" && !capabilities("X11")) stop("No supported bitmap graphics device. Use desktop RStudio or R with Cairo.")
render <- function(id,kind,w,h){
  stem<-paste0("Fkhadah_Figure_",id)
  path<-switch(kind,tiff=file.path(root,"TIFF_800dpi",paste0(stem,".tiff")),pdf=file.path(root,"PDF_vector",paste0(stem,".pdf")),png=file.path(root,"PNG_review",paste0(stem,".png")))
  if(kind=="tiff") tiff(path,width=w,height=h,units="in",res=800,compression="lzw",pointsize=10,bg="white",type=np)
  if(kind=="png") png(path,width=w,height=h,units="in",res=300,pointsize=10,bg="white",type=np)
  if(kind=="pdf") pdf(path,width=w,height=h,pointsize=10,family="Helvetica",useDingbats=FALSE,onefile=TRUE,bg="white")
  on.exit(dev.off(),add=TRUE); plots[[id]](); invisible(path)
}
for(i in seq_along(ids)){
  for(kind in c("tiff","pdf","png")) render(ids[i],kind,size[i,1],size[i,2]); message("Completed Figure ",ids[i]," (3 formats)")
}
source_descr <- c(source_descr,"V41 all 405 reference P-C cells","V41 archived P-C sensitivity, 162 selected profiles","V41 all 30 DGM-by-size RF profiles","V41 fixed-characteristic clinical reweighting, aggregate counts")
source_descr <- c(source_descr,"V42 reconstructed reference endpoints; 90 cells","V42 same V39 evaluation streams; endpoint membership and width")
manifest <- data.frame(figure=ids,source=source_descr,width_in=size[,1],height_in=size[,2],tiff_dpi=800,top="upright landscape as rendered",status="replotted_from_embedded_data")
write.csv(manifest,file.path(root,"Figure_Provenance.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
files <- list.files(root,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE,pattern="\\.(tiff|pdf|png)$"); stopifnot(length(files)==75L,all(file.info(files)$size>0))
write.csv(data.frame(path=substring(files,nchar(root)+2L),bytes=file.info(files)$size,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(files))),file.path(root,"Figure_File_Inventory.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
writeLines(c("FWKC-SAI V42: 25 figures / 75 files",sprintf("Clinical crossover: %.12f; direct-loss crossover: %.12f",ck,cl),"Plot reproduction from original/reaggregated outputs only; no Monte Carlo rerun.","Archived S1, S4, S5 and Figure 14 retain original scope; no underlying HF refit or masking refit claimed.","R rendering differs visually from the V41 Python publication figures; all data and figure identities retained.",capture.output(sessionInfo())),file.path(root,"RUN_LOG.txt"))
message("SUCCESS: 25 figures, TIFF/PDF/PNG, with exact plot-data CSVs and provenance.\nOutput directory: ",root)
})
